item.title: Kansas bathroom bill requires ID gender markers to match assigned sex at birth
item.description: Kansas has enacted a law that requires individuals to use bathrooms and locker rooms that match their sex at birth, and that state-issued identification must also match their sex at birth, with no grace period for updating documents.

item.title: Feds remove protections for lesser prairie chicken; Kansas lawmakers celebrate
item.description: There used to be millions of lesser prairie chickens, but now there are only about 30,000 in Kansas, Colorado, New Mexico, Oklahoma and Texas.
